blockingIssues.description: packages/extension/content.ts still calls clearActionOverlay() and clearBadge() instead of destroyOverlay()/destroyBadge(), so injected overlay and badge nodes remain attached and VAL-CRIT-001 is not satisfied.

packages/extension/content.ts defines ContentScriptHandler.destroy() but never stores the handler instance or wires destroy() to pagehide/beforeunload, so removeListener is never called and the content-script runtime listener still leaks.

Six empty catch blocks remain in test files (tests/e2e/run-orchestrator-runtime-e2e.ts, tests/relay/run-relay-tests.ts, tests/relay/run-electron-agent-tests.ts, tests/perf/run-perf-profile.ts), so the codebase-wide VAL-CRIT-004 assertion is not met.

Meaningless empty catch handlers remain on fire-and-forget promises in packages/extension/recording/recording-coordinator.ts, sidepanel/ui/chat/panel-recorder.ts, and sidepanel/ui/core/state-manager.ts, leaving silent failure paths and failing VAL-CRIT-005.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Ensure mission guidance only tells workers to invoke a custom skill when that skill is actually registered and invokable, or explicitly instruct them to read the project SKILL.md file directly as the fallback path.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature fix-resize-observer-leak transcript shows Skill("cleanup-worker") failed with "Skill not found" even though mission AGENTS.md says the mission uses cleanup-worker for all cleanup tasks.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Strengthen the memory-leak checklist to require proof that new cleanup helpers are reachable from real lifecycle hooks or call sites, not merely implemented.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both fix-dom-element-leaks and fix-runtime-listener-leaks added destroy()/destroyBadge()/destroyOverlay() helpers, but review found the content-script lifecycle still never calls them.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: For codebase-wide error-handling tasks, require repo-wide verification (including tests when the feature says "codebase") and explicitly disallow empty `.catch(() => {})` handlers as acceptable floating-promise remediation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-empty-catch-blocks verified only packages/ and left six empty catches in tests; fix-floating-promises left four production fire-and-forget calls with empty catch handlers that still silence failures.

rejectedObservations.observation: The second cleanup-hook observation from fix-runtime-listener-leaks duplicated the same root pattern already captured from fix-dom-element-leaks.
